[CONSENT ITEMS FOR BOARD ACTION [Consent Items 1 - 18]]
RESOLUTION NO. - Adoption of the staff report; and Approval of a Contract with ServiceWear Apparel Inc.: By joining Region 4 Education Service Center Contract R251002, covering ongoing uniform needs for Operations and Maintenance staff at Los Angeles International Airport and Van Nuys Airport, for cost not to exceed $65,000 and an expiration date of March 13, 2027 (Daniel Hughes)
